metadata.case_name: NG YUEK LANG SOPHIA v. CHIU KING WA

plaintiff.occupation_before: used to work as waitress/saleslady for about 5 years and receptionist/clerk for about 10 years
plaintiff.occupation_after: not employed, dependent on Comprehensive Social Security Assistance
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: plans to go back to work when her son goes to Primary one (September 2018)

source: The plaintiff had head/occiput concussion, neck sprain/ contusion, back sprain/contusion, and abrasion of left elbow, right knee and both shins.

injuries.description: lumbar degenerative changes including facet hypertrophy at L3/4, L4/5 and L5/S1, mild disc protrusions at L4/5, L5/S1 and S1/2 and annular tear at S1/2
source: Lumbar MRI showed that facet hypertrophy at L3/4, L4/5 and L5/S1 level was pre-existing and degenerative in origin. MRI also showed relative mild disc protrusions at L4/5, L5/S1 and S1/2 levels and the annular tear at S1/2.

injuries.description: increased psychiatric symptoms and Post Traumatic Stress Disorder symptoms (nightmares of the Accident) and minor residual psychiatric symptoms
source: Dr Lai ... diagnosed that she suffered increased psychiatric symptoms and Post Traumatic Stress Disorder symptoms in the form of nightmares of the Accident and she was likely suffering from minor residual psychiatric symptoms.

manifestations.description: neck and back pain and stiffness; headache; limitation of range of movement of back; decrease in range of movement of neck and back; pain on bending down or raising hands; difficulty in carrying heavy objects and having prolonged standing, walking and sitting
numbness over right upper and lower limbs (reported on occupational therapy assessment)
anxiety, depression, insomnia, nightmares and flashback of the Accident
loss of cervical lordosis; reduced forward flexion, backward extension and sideward flexion of neck and back (less than normal range at joint examination)

treatments_received: ambulance transfer to Accident and Emergency Department
admitted and discharged same day from Queen Elizabeth Hospital
physiotherapy (initiated 17 October 2014; completed 5 sessions, defaulted 6 sessions; further programme from 12 May 2015 attended 4 sessions defaulted 3)
treatments_future: continuation of psychiatric treatment in public psychiatric clinic once in 6 to 8 weeks (Dr Lai)
Dr Lai considered it likely she required another 6 months of psychiatric treatment

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Unable to do household chores like cleaning the toilet and kitchen, wiping and mopping the floor, washing, ironing, grocery shopping, cooking, cleaning the furniture and the windows; required part-time domestic helper
